periods.label: Loki chairs Denatus and challenges Bell's record

status.concern: Bell exceeded Ais's level-up speed record

appearance.overview: A red-haired goddess with narrow smiling eyes who moderates the meeting and then opens them sharply when serious.

voice_quality.tone: playful as chair, sharp when interrogating Hestia

distinctive: thin smiling eyes that open when serious

personality.summary: Irreverent and playful as Denatus chair, but fiercely suspicious when Bell's level-up record surpasses Ais's precedent.
desires: force an explanation for Bell's rapid growth
flaws: jealous framing makes her easier to deflect
personality.inner_conflict: Her suspicion of Bell's growth is genuine, but her rivalry with Hestia and pride in Ais complicate how others read her motives.

decision_pattern.investigation: Uses direct public confrontation, then gives a grudging warning when larger danger appears.

quote_samples: 一个半月就让我们的『恩惠』升华，这究竟是怎么一回事？

mannerisms: raises a hand to start the meeting
slams Bell's file on the table
leans close to Hestia while warning her
habits.daily_routine: Chairs Denatus while Loki Familia's main expedition members are away.
quirks: enjoys teasing until serious stakes appear

formative_events: Ais's first level-up in one year had been a historic record
background.pre_story: Her familia reported the upper-floor Minotaur incident and Ais recently reached Lv.6.

relationships.hestia: Rival goddess whom she interrogates and later warns.
relationships.freya: Old acquaintance and rival whose intervention she distrusts.
relationships.ais-wallenstein: Her prized child whose first level-up record was surpassed by Bell.
relationships.bell-cranel: Suspicious new record-holder she has not personally accepted.

knowledge: Knows Ais needed one year for her first level-up
Knows Bell did it in about one and a half months
Recognizes Freya defending a male as a warning sign
periods.summary: Loki chairs Denatus, exposes the gods' naming chaos, then publicly challenges Hestia over Bell's impossible growth. Freya blocks her, but Loki later warns Hestia that Freya's defense of Bell is dangerous.

key_events.summary: Loki interrogates Hestia about Bell surpassing Ais's level-up record.
Loki tells Hestia to watch out because Freya protected Bell.
